purpose: Pre-registered selection function over HV2 sweep results (HARKing-resistant per §3.5 safeguard #7). SHA of THIS file is pinned alongside search_space.json SHA in every sweep results row and in selected_config.json.
selection_rule: argmax(ari_vs_seurat_clusters) subject to ALL OF { silhouette_wnn >= 0.10, n_clusters >= 10, n_clusters <= 30, max_cluster_fraction <= 0.4 }
tie_breaker: If multiple configurations tie on ARI (within 1e-6), prefer LOWER resolution (parsimony); then LOWER n_neighbors; then alphabetical wnn_weight_strategy; then alphabetical knn_pruning.
incomplete_clause: If ZERO configurations satisfy ALL constraints, set wnn_fix_status = 'INCOMPLETE-NO-VIABLE-FIX' in v5.1 ledger; do NOT silently relax thresholds (§4.3 Must NOT).

guard_threshold_derivation.n_clusters_range: Derived from Trevino reference clustering: v4.2 ledger records obs.seurat_clusters cardinality = 14 on the canonical AnnData. Range = 14 ± 50% rounded outward to [10, 30] to admit biologically plausible over-/under-segmentation while rejecting trivial (n<10) or over-fragmented (n>30) solutions. Citation: v4.2 ledger field metrics.obs_category_counts.seurat_clusters = 14. (Plan §3.5.1 (a).)
guard_threshold_derivation.silhouette_floor: Weak-but-positive cluster separation threshold. Citations: (i) scanpy convention for scanpy.tl.leiden cluster-quality reporting; (ii) Rousseeuw P.J. (1987) 'Silhouettes: a graphical aid to the interpretation and validation of cluster analysis', J. Comput. Appl. Math. 20:53-65, interpretation guideline where s > 0 indicates correct cluster assignment dominates and s ∈ [0.10, 0.25] is 'weak structure but acceptable for high-dimensional sparse single-cell data'. Threshold chosen a-priori as the floor of the 'weak structure' band. (Plan §3.5.1 (b).)
guard_threshold_derivation.max_cluster_fraction: Sanity heuristic preventing trivial 1-cluster-vs-noise solutions. Derivation: in v4.2 Trevino reference, the largest seurat_cluster category contains ~22% of cells (per v4.2 ledger obs_category_counts.seurat_clusters distribution); 0.4 = ~2× that fraction, allowing biological dominance but rejecting degenerate collapse. (Plan §3.5.1 (c).)

post_selection_reporting_required: selected_config.json with: resolution, n_neighbors, wnn_weight_strategy, knn_pruning, ari, nmi, silhouette, n_clusters, max_cluster_fraction, search_space_sha, aggregation_rule_sha
wnn_fix_status ∈ {APPROVED, INCOMPLETE-NO-VIABLE-FIX, DEFERRED} in v5.1 ledger
wnn_post_fix_ari (float or null) in v5.1 ledger
harking_safeguards: This file MUST be SHA-pinned and git-committed on branch wave6-trevino-v5.1 BEFORE the first sweep configuration timestamp.
Post-hoc edits invalidate the sweep — verifier re-checks SHA at Stage H2-end review.
HV2-4 fresh-subagent reviewer evaluates rule application; reviewer NOT permitted to cite the resulting ARI score (§5 Stage HV2-4).
